summary: Frontend-web has 8 pass cases and 8 code_mismatch findings. The most critical are: (1) CheckoutCommitButton sends the idempotency key as an HTTP header on the wrong endpoint (generic proxy) instead of body-field on the dedicated /api/checkout/commit handler — the dedicated handler does not exist, so the server-side idempotency-key validation and forwarding logic specified in TD is never exercised; (2) The Orders list page fetches /api/proxy/order/list instead of /api/proxy/order/list-mine, silently routing to a non-existent path; (3) TabBar uses /products for the Search tab instead of the TD-specified /search route. Secondary mismatches: viewport meta missing viewport-fit=cover + maximum-scale=1; CartLineItem non-checkoutable badge text differs from spec; profile logout uses form/urlencoded not JSON; Tailwind brand token names diverge from TD (missing DEFAULT/dark/soft). No spec_incomplete or spec_wrong findings. All fail rows carry evidence.

findings.description: TD idempotency_strategy: client sends idempotencyKey in POST body field; route handler reads it and forwards as 'Idempotency-Key' HTTP header; handler MUST reject 400 if field missing. Code sends 'Idempotency-Key' as a request header directly to /api/proxy/checkout/commit (the generic catch-all); no dedicated /api/checkout/commit/route.ts exists. The specified 400 VALIDATION_ERROR rejection path and body-field→header forwarding are absent.
findings.recommendation: Create frontend/app/api/checkout/commit/route.ts as a dedicated handler: read idempotencyKey from JSON body, reject 400 VALIDATION_ERROR if missing, forward as 'Idempotency-Key' header on downstream POST. Update CheckoutCommitButton to POST { idempotencyKey, ...} to /api/checkout/commit (not /api/proxy/checkout/commit).

findings.description: TD route_handlers list 'POST /api/proxy/order/list-mine' → order.list-mine. OrdersPage fetches /api/proxy/order/list which the generic proxy maps to /api/v1/order/order/list — a non-existent endpoint. The correct path is /api/proxy/order/list-mine.
findings.recommendation: Change the fetch URL in OrdersPage from /api/proxy/order/list to /api/proxy/order/list-mine.

findings.description: TD directory_layout specifies tab routes as: /, /search, /cart, /orders, /profile. TabBar code uses /products for the Search tab (href='/products', label='ค้นหา'). The spec-required Search tab route /search does not exist; /products is the products listing page.
findings.recommendation: Create app/(tabs)/search/page.tsx at route /search (per TD directory_layout). Update TabBar TABS array to use href='/search' for the search tab. Or if the design decision is /products, document the deviation and route the tab to /products consistently — but that contradicts TD.

findings.description: TD scaffold.viewport.html_meta requires: content='width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover, maximum-scale=1'. layout.tsx exports viewport = { width: 390, initialScale: 1 } — missing viewport-fit=cover (needed for iOS safe-area notch) and maximum-scale=1 (prevents browser zoom on input focus).
findings.recommendation: Replace the Next.js viewport export with a manual <meta name='viewport'> tag in the <head> containing the full TD-specified string, or use Next.js Metadata viewport object with { width: 'device-width', initialScale: 1, viewportFit: 'cover', maximumScale: 1 }.

findings.description: TD components_ui CartLineItem specifies the non-checkoutable badge text as 'ไม่สามารถสั่งซื้อได้' (per CART-005). Code renders 'สินค้าไม่พร้อมจำหน่าย'. Text differs from the locked TD copy.
findings.recommendation: Change CartLineItem line 99 badge text from 'สินค้าไม่พร้อมจำหน่าย' to 'ไม่สามารถสั่งซื้อได้' per TD components_ui and CART-005.

findings.description: Profile page submits logout via an HTML <form action='/api/proxy/identity/auth/logout' method='post'>. This sends Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded. TD security_posture requires all mutating route handlers to require Content-Type: application/json to block naive HTML-form CSRF. The logout handler reads a JSON body; a form submit sends the wrong content type and bypasses the Content-Type guard.
findings.recommendation: Replace the native form submit with a Client Component BtnLogout that calls fetch('/api/proxy/identity/auth/logout', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({}) }) per TD components_ui BtnLogout spec.

findings.description: TD visual_system.brand.tailwind_token specifies: theme.extend.colors.brand = { DEFAULT: '#1a8060', dark: '#0f5a44', soft: '#ecfdf5' }. Code defines a numeric scale (50/100/300/400/500/600/700/900) with no DEFAULT, dark, or soft keys. Components using brand-dark and brand-soft class names would silently fall back to undefined.
findings.recommendation: Replace the numeric scale with the TD-specified shape: brand: { DEFAULT: '#1a8060', dark: '#0f5a44', soft: '#ecfdf5' }. The numeric variants may be kept as additionals if needed but the named tokens are required.

findings.description: TD route_handler_topology lists POST /api/payment/simulate as one of 8 dedicated handlers (withAuth, outcome field). PaymentSimulator POSTs to /api/proxy/payment/simulate (generic proxy). No dedicated /api/payment/simulate/route.ts exists. The generic proxy applies withAuth uniformly but lacks the customer-facing outcome-field validation and the specific downstream URL pattern the TD enumerates.
findings.recommendation: Create frontend/app/api/payment/simulate/route.ts as a dedicated handler: withAuth, validate outcome field (SUCCESS|FAILED|TIMEOUT), forward to payment service. Update PaymentSimulator to POST to /api/payment/simulate.
